plugin.name: Grand Theft Auto / London Widescreen Fix
MAIN.ResX.description: Output size in pixels. 0 selects the desktop size for this axis. Restart after editing through the hub.
MAIN.ResY.description: Output size in pixels. 0 selects the desktop size for this axis. Restart after editing through the hub.
MAIN.WindowMode.description: Fullscreen is the game's exclusive mode, which changes the display mode. Windowed is a window of the game's resolution, centred without a frame; Borderless covers the monitor with the picture scaled to fit. Alt+Enter switches between the two. Switching to or from Fullscreen needs a restart.
MAIN.HudSafeArea.description: Distance of the HUD from the screen's edges, in the game's 640x480 pixels.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Keeps the HUD in a centred box of this aspect ratio, such as 16:9 on wider screens. Auto uses the whole screen.
MAIN.SoftwareBuffer.description: Renders the game through the fix's own framebuffer. Restart required.
MAIN.FixFramePacing.description: Waits for each frame with a precise timer instead of the game's busy loop. Restart required.
CAMERA.SmoothFollow.description: The camera follows the player smoothly instead of jumping with the game's dead zone.
CAMERA.FollowTime.description: Seconds the smooth camera takes to catch up with the player.
CAMERA.HeightTime.description: Seconds the camera takes to change its height with the player's speed.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the visible area of the world. 1.0 is the original camera; bigger shows more.
CAMERA.RotateWithPlayer.description: The camera turns with the player's direction.
CAMERA.RotateInVehicles.description: The camera turns with the vehicle the player drives.
CAMERA.RotateOnFoot.description: The camera turns with the player on foot.
CAMERA.RotationSmoothing.description: Seconds the camera takes to follow a turn.
CAMERA.ToggleRotationKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.ModernControls.description: Uses the modern key bindings of the Controls page instead of the game's classic controls.
INPUT.MouseAim.description: The player aims at the mouse cursor.
INPUT.StickThrottle.description: The stick's distance from the centre sets the vehicle's throttle.
INPUT.StickDeadzone.description: Part of the stick's movement around the centre that is ignored.
INPUT.MoveUpKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.MoveDownKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.MoveLeftKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.MoveRightKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.FireKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.EnterVehicleKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.JumpKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.SpecialKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.PreviousWeaponKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.NextWeaponKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.PauseKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
